$comment: Copy to config/users.json and edit, then run: npm run users:apply
Each user is one SIP extension and one softphone login.
extension  - the dialable number (3 digits, 1XX, matched by the dialplan)
name       - shown as the internal caller ID and in the directory
password   - the login password for the web app; replaced by a hash on
first apply, so you can write a plaintext password here and
sipPassword- the SIP digest secret; generated if omitted
role       - 'agent' or 'admin' (admin sees the switchboard dashboard)
groups     - ring groups this user is in, e.g. ['reception']
queues     - call queues this user takes calls for, with a penalty:
did        - optional direct inward dial number for this extension
outboundCallerId - optional; defaults to the company MAIN_DID
voicemailPin     - numeric PIN for *97; generated if omitted

reception.description: Who picks up the main line
